name: Malleco Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A subregion of Southern Chile, one of the five principal wine regions of Chile. The South covers the Bío Bío and Araucanía regions and is made up of three districts: the Itata, Bío Bío and Malleco valleys.
